notes: Network orders use any wood: a recipe that takes any planks, slabs, logs, wool or coal uses whatever kind storage has, and crafts more from what it has (oak logs into oak planks) instead of asking for bamboo. Orders also know every crafting table recipe now (slabs, stone bricks and more). The Network Crafter's Search button works like the Deepcore Crafting Table's: the screen closes, you type a name, and tapping the Crafter again shows the results. Also in 4.51.0: Assemblers work for network orders only (no pipes, no recipe grid).
